visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a busy outdoor scene at the Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo. A large crowd of people is walking across the intersection in a time-lapse effect. Multiple large billboards are visible in the background, including advertisements for DMM, Forever 21, and DHC. The main character, a young man with black hair wearing a dark blue shirt, stands in the foreground pointing towards the camera. (2) A graphic overlay of a white smartphone with the number '10' appears in the center of the frame. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a wooden table where two hands are pointing at square cards with star ratings on them. This transitions into a screen capture of a mobile app showing a map of the Shinjuku area with various pins and restaurant names. (3) The creator is seen in an indoor room with a plain wall, wearing a brown shirt and waving his index finger in a 'no' gesture. The camera then shows a retail environment at a 7-Eleven counter where a smartphone is being scanned by a handheld barcode reader. Various snacks and drinks are visible on the shelves in the background. (4) A crowded indoor station hallway is shown with many people walking in different directions. The scene shifts to an outdoor street where a black Toyota JPN Taxi with 'GO' branding pulls up to the curb. The creator is then seen sitting in the backseat of the vehicle, wearing glasses and a white t-shirt, looking out the window. (5) Three young women are seen outdoors, smiling and holding multiple shopping bags, suggesting a shopping trip. The visual then transitions to a currency converter app on a smartphone screen, showing exchange rates for JPY, USD, and TWD. The creator appears in a thinking pose with a lightbulb icon overlay, then shows a mathematical calculation on a white background. (6) A bright, clean indoor bathroom featuring a modern white washlet toilet is shown. A map interface with numerous red and yellow pins appears, indicating locations. The video concludes with the creator standing in front of a digital collage of Japanese landmarks, including the Tokyo Skytree and a large Buddha statue, while a red bookmark icon is displayed on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comprehensive travel guide designed to provide practical utility for tourists visiting Japan. By showcasing ten specific mobile applications across various categories such as dining, payment, transportation, and daily needs, the creator aims to simplify the travel experience for Chinese-speaking audiences. The energetic presentation and rapid editing style maintain viewer engagement while delivering dense, actionable information.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides a specific referral code ('mf-mvzyfn') for the GO Taxi app and explicitly encourages viewers to use it to receive coupons.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high density of variety-show style text overlays and fast-paced editing typical of social media short-form content. The integration of screen captures and real-world footage effectively bridges the gap between digital tools and physical travel experiences.
